title: Firebase Runtime Configuration
description: Schema for the Firebase Runtime Configuration file (.firebaserc).

projectTargets.description: Resource target configurations for a specific Firebase project ID.

hosting.description: Maps hosting target names (specified in firebase.json) to an array containing the Firebase Hosting site name.

additionalProperties.description: Array of Firebase Hosting site name(s) associated with this target name.

storage.description: Maps storage target names (specified in firebase.json) to an array of Cloud Storage bucket names.

additionalProperties.description: Array of Cloud Storage bucket name(s) associated with this target name.

database.description: Maps Realtime Database target names (specified in firebase.json) to an array of Realtime Database instance names.

additionalProperties.description: Array of Realtime Database instance name(s) associated with this target name.

firestore.description: Maps Firestore target names (specified in firebase.json) to an array of Firestore database IDs.

additionalProperties.description: Array of Firestore database ID(s) associated with this target name.
Resource targets for additional target types, mapping target names to an array of resource identifiers.
Array of resource identifiers associated with this target name.

projectEtags.description: ETags for resources within a specific Firebase project.

extensionInstances.description: Maps deployed Firebase Extension instance IDs to their deployed ETag hash.

additionalProperties.description: The ETag string returned by the Firebase Extensions API for this instance.

projects.description: Maps project aliases (such as 'default', 'staging', or 'production') to Firebase Project IDs.

default.description: The default Firebase Project ID used when no project or alias is explicitly specified.

additionalProperties.description: The Firebase Project ID associated with this alias.

targets.description: Maps Firebase project IDs to named resource targets for multi-resource deployments.

etags.description: Stores resource ETags per project to detect drift and out-of-band updates during extension deployments.

dataconnectEmulatorConfig.description: Deprecated configuration for the Firebase Data Connect emulator.

postgres.description: PostgreSQL database configuration for the emulator.

localConnectionString.description: Connection string to a local PostgreSQL instance.
